title: USAspending Federal Contracts & Grants
description: Search federal contract, grant, loan and IDV awards on USAspending.gov: recipient, UEI, amount, outlays, description, agency, NAICS/PSC, dates and place of performance, with a link to each award. Filter by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, amount.
why: Who the government is paying, for what, and when the work ends. The source of truth for incumbent research, teaming and competitor tracking.
useCases: GovCon BD teams finding incumbents and recompete targets by NAICS or agency
Subcontractors finding primes that won work in their state
Analysts and reporters tracking federal spending by recipient

agency.title: Awarding agency (top tier)
agency.description: Exact name, e.g. Department of Defense

minAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAmount.description: Only awards at or above this amount.

startDate.title: Action date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
startDate.description: Awards with activity on or after this date.

endDate.title: Action date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
endDate.description: Awards with activity on or before this date.

limits: Sorted by award amount, largest first. USAspending lags FPDS by a few days.
